title.narrative: FSDA Core Funding RDEL - Financial Sector Deepening Africa

description.narrative: FCDO Core RDel support for FSD Africa. FSDA supports African countries to deepen their financial sectors and improve the way they are regulated, manage risk and extend financial services to the poor. It does this through: Technical assistance and capacity building to African Governments and Regulators; Grants and/or returnable grants to develop new financial products and services; Research, analysis and intelligence-gathering to provide policy-makers, regulators, development actors, investors and financial service providers with market insights and information.
